title: [universe] eligibilityForBarCount: characterization test for the history eligibility levels
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for eligibilityForBarCount in src/universe.ts: eligibility levels
- eligibilityForBarCount(0) is "LEVEL_0"
- eligibilityForBarCount(19) is "LEVEL_1"
- eligibilityForBarCount(251) is "LEVEL_2"
- eligibilityForBarCount(252) is "LEVEL_3"
- eligibilityForBarCount(1.5) throws INVALID_BAR_COUNT

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v2): Peace's task (source: peace). Only -1 (throws) and 20 (LEVEL_2) are tested; LEVEL_0, LEVEL_1, LEVEL_3, the 19/251/252 boundaries and a fractional count are not; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 8b1f413 (Workspace main 616c083, live 26-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v2); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with eligibilityForBarCount stubbed); suite 574/574 with all eleven new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok.
